summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K to disclose a registered direct offering. It entered into a securities purchase agreement with institutional investors to sell 11,792,455 common shares plus warrants at a combined price of $2.12 per unit. Gross proceeds are ~$25 million. Maxim Group LLC is the placement agent. The offering is a routine at-the-market/equity financing under an effective shelf registration statement, not a special-situation event. It does not involve a merger, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or other transformative corporate action, and there is no change of control or strategic review. The expected close on May 18, 2026 is subject to customary conditions.
